messages:
sam: scheduling canary for runtime-bundle v3.2.0-quant-mix in night window, us-east-2 only. low traffic slice (0.5%).

natalie: thanks — what's the deploy command so I can paste into runbook? :eyes:

sam: `/deploy runtime-bundle v3.2.0-quant-mix --canary=0.5% --regions=us-east-2 --window=02:00-05:00 --pin-ttl=4h`

jordan: quick checklist: smoke test image, kv-cache sanity, p99 tokenization, kernel fallback rate. if p99 up >20% or OOMs >3/min in canary -> rollback.

alice: add regression gate on our eval set too — if top-10 BLEU/QA drop >3% trigger alert. natalie can you add that to release-notes?

natalie: adding note now. also flagging the dedicated customers list that might need heads-up (legal/regulatory).

kevin: I'll pre-warm the KV cache buckets and spin a staging run with sample trace. copying the preflight script:
```
./tools/preflight.sh --image runtime-bundle:v3.2.0-quant-mix --smoke 1000 --kv-warm 1m
```

deploy-bot: ack: canary scheduled by sam for 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z (thread 3339991111). rolling to 0.5% in us-east-2.

ops-oncall: i'll be monitoring infra dashboard. if we see kernel-fallback hits >1% or eviction >10/s escalate.

sam: note — this bundle contains a new matmul kernel (matmul_fused_v3) plus a fallback path. expected fallback rate ~0.05% in perf tests.

(02:07) deploy-bot: canary started. instance ids: i-0a1b2c3d...

(02:12) kevin: staging run logs look clean. no mem regressions.

(02:22) telemetry: p99 latency +9% (baseline 110ms -> 120ms), kernel_fallback_rate 0.6% (above expected).

jordan: 0.6% fallback is higher than perf run. watching whether it's correlated to seq-length >1024. kevin can you check trace?

kevin: looking — fallback spikes on long-context few requests, trace attached (short snippet):
```
[TRACE] request=req-8b3f seq=1832 kernel=matmul_fused_v3 -> fallback matmul_v2 at step 4
```

sam: decision? Do we continue to roll or hold+increase sample to validate distribution?

alice: my vote hold at 0.5% for now. increase telemetry window to 30m and add canary weight if fallback stabilizes under 0.3%.

natalie: updated release-notes with a FAQ about the fallback and mitigation steps. also noted pin-ttl so it won't auto-unpin during night.

(02:45) telemetry: OOMs 0, eviction spikes gone, kernel_fallback_rate trending down to 0.28% over last 10m, p99 back to +4%.

ops-oncall: still watching. if fallback >0.5% again within 15m -> rollback.

sam: agreed. holding. i'll escalate if we see regressions. thanks all. :thumbsup:

(03:02) deploy-bot: canary complete (6.6% of planned window). status: stable. will keep bundle pinned for 3.5h (pin-ttl).

jordan: follow-up action — open an ops card to instrument seq-length->kernel mapping in logs, so we can root-cause higher fallback on long contexts.

kevin: i'll take the card. also will run an expanded perf job against sequences 512-4096 overnight.

natalie: done — release notes + customer heads-up drafted. tagging eng-sre for visibility.

sam: closing thread for now. if anyone sees a regression reopen or ping ops-oncall. :white_check_mark:
